rationale: Use global GDELT GKG Hormuz-mention share as the closest proxy to daily news mentions of 'Hormuz', and Brent futures log returns as the main oil-price response, standardizing news intensity (zscore) and leaving daily price moves in return space to test whether spikes in Hormuz coverage during blockade phases lead next‑day Brent moves, allowing a 1–2 day lead/lag.
